# Upstream notices for sharp-libvips 1.3.2

This directory contains two unmodified files from the official
`lovell/sharp-libvips` repository for `@img/sharp-libvips-darwin-arm64@1.3.2`.
The npm package's `gitHead` and the upstream tag `v1.3.2` both resolve to
commit `4da6d14c0d59866adfb9d8cf52bcaa53846dc4f6`.

| File | Source at the pinned commit | SHA-256 |
|---|---|---|
| `THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md` | [Upstream notices](https://github.com/lovell/sharp-libvips/blob/4da6d14c0d59866adfb9d8cf52bcaa53846dc4f6/THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md) | `25ffcfa69e28b1913ced27ec778b90f24911a1bb3021253577e8b0af55db0d49` |
| `LICENSE-packaging.txt` | [Upstream repository license](https://github.com/lovell/sharp-libvips/blob/4da6d14c0d59866adfb9d8cf52bcaa53846dc4f6/LICENSE) | `b40930bbcf80744c86c46a12bc9da056641d722716c378f5659b9e555ef833e1` |

`LICENSE-packaging.txt` covers the upstream packaging scripts. The npm metadata
declares `LGPL-3.0-or-later` for the binary package. The notices identify bundled
libraries and their licenses. A full distribution review still needs to verify
the library inventory, the required license texts, and the corresponding sources.
